setup.description: Choose where OpenKara should keep your songs and karaoke tracks. You can move this library later, including to an external drive.
setup.createNewDescription: Choose a location. OpenKara will create a new folder there.
setup.openExistingDescription: Choose a library folder you already set up.
setup.dialogTitleCreate: Choose a location for your Karaoke Library
setup.stemModeDescription: This controls how songs are separated for karaoke mode. You can change this later in settings.
setup.fourStemDetail: More control over individual instruments, ~2× disk space

confirmUpgrade.title: Upgrade All Songs to 4-Stem
confirmUpgrade.message: This will re-separate all songs using 4-stem mode. Disk space usage for stems will approximately double.

library.confirmDeleteMessage: This will remove the selected songs from the library and delete their managed files.

importCdgChoice.title: Choose a CD+G audio file
importCdgChoice.message: {{cdgName}} matches multiple selected audio files. Pick which track should use this graphics file.

queue.title: Queue
queue.dragInstructions: To reorder the queue, focus a reorder button, press space or enter to pick up the song, use the arrow keys to move it, then press space or enter again to drop it.

lyrics.noLyrics: No lyrics available for this track
lyrics.supportsFormats: Supports LRC timed format or plain text

stemMode.label: Stem Separation Mode
stemMode.description: Controls how new songs are separated. Existing separations are not affected.

modelVariant.label: AI Model
modelVariant.description: Choose between faster processing or higher quality separation.
modelVariant.htdemucsFtDescription: May produce artifacts in accompaniment tracks
modelVariant.ftWarningMessage: The fine-tuned model may produce audible noise or artifacts in accompaniment tracks for some songs. Vocal separation quality may be slightly better. Use at your own risk.

hideBatchSeparate.label: Separate All Button
hideBatchSeparate.hide: Hide the Separate All button in the sidebar
hideBatchSeparate.description: Use this if you want future songs separated in a different mode but don't want to re-separate existing songs.

dangerZone.label: Danger Zone
dangerZone.deleteStemsDescription: Remove all cached stem files to free disk space
dangerZone.deleteLyricsDescription: Remove all fetched and cached lyrics. Lyrics will be re-fetched when songs are played.
dangerZone.downgradeStemsDescription: Remove drums, bass, and other stems from all 4-stem songs. Vocals and accompaniment are preserved.
dangerZone.deleteModelDescription: Remove the downloaded model file to free disk space. It will need to be re-downloaded if you select this model again.
dangerZone.confirmDeleteModel: Are you sure you want to delete this model? You will need to re-download it to use it again.

confirmDeleteStems.title: Delete All Separated Stems
confirmDeleteStems.message: This will permanently delete all cached stem files. Songs will need to be re-separated to use karaoke mode.

confirmDowngradeStems.title: Downgrade All Songs to 2-Stem
confirmDowngradeStems.message: This will remove the individual drums, bass, and other stems from all 4-stem songs. An accompaniment track will be created by mixing them. This cannot be undone.

confirmDeleteLyrics.title: Delete All Cached Lyrics
confirmDeleteLyrics.message: This will permanently delete all cached lyrics. Lyrics will be automatically re-fetched when songs are played.

bootstrap.modelRequired: AI separation model required for karaoke mode.
